title: Anthropic shares fall below IPO price, a worrying sign for AI startups
lede: Anthropic stock slid under its $83 IPO price on Tuesday, touching $76 by midday, less than a week after it opened on Nasdaq at $111.50.

points: The midday low was nearly 12% below Monday's close.
Underwriters usually price an offering below its expected trading value, so falling under it is read as a bad sign.
VCs and other observers have treated Anthropic's trading as a gauge of how public investors value the AI sector.
Nvidia also fell more than 7% by midday, after gaining over 30% on Monday when Jensen Huang returned as CEO.

sections.text: If the shares keep trading poorly, TechCrunch expects pressure on private AI startup valuations and weaker IPO prospects for other AI companies, which affects how the startups behind many AI tools get funded.
